subject.title: feat: apply messages.responsePrefix to message tool outbound sends

question: Should agent-originated `message(action=send)` deliveries receive selected provider/model/thinking context for `messages.responsePrefix` templates, or should tool sends intentionally remain static/identity-only?
rationale: Current main deliberately skips unresolved dynamic prefixes because the send path does not perform model selection; completing the request requires choosing a runtime contract and owner boundary.

options.title: Thread Run Context Into Sends
options.body: Apply dynamic responsePrefix templates for agent-originated message-tool sends using the actual selected provider, model, full model ref, and thinking level, while keeping unresolved-placeholder skipping for sends without run context.

options.title: Document Static/Identity Only
options.body: Keep current behavior and document that message-tool sends support only static and identity prefixes unless a future owner designs run-context plumbing.

options.title: Split A Narrow Design Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical umbrella only until maintainers open a narrower design issue for selected-model prefix parity.

recommendation.title: Thread Run Context Into Sends
recommendation.body: Apply dynamic responsePrefix templates for agent-originated message-tool sends using the actual selected provider, model, full model ref, and thinking level, while keeping unresolved-placeholder skipping for sends without run context.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared reply-prefix and per-agent prefix history makes this the best available routing candidate for the product-boundary decision.
